paragraphs: See the entry R' Ada bar Shimon.[^1]

notes.text: The heading has Idi bar Shimon; the pointer has Ada with an abbreviated title. Its בר״ש is read contextually as bar Shimon, but could include an abbreviated personal title before Shimon. The older note expanded that alternative as Rabbi; the title is unresolved, so that alternative is bar R' Shimon.
